Name: After Midnight Speed Buff
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses Buff Framework to apply a +3 speed buff to the farmer between the hours of midnight and 2 am.

The mod also plays the prairie king boss music while the buff is active, and causes the farmer to glow golden like Invincible Mario:

[youtube]wGwRHGC6-Js[/youtube]

You can change the speed buff amount and the music in the config. Set Sound to "" to disable the music.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17746]Buff Framework[/url].
